description: This file contains C++ source code implementing GDBus variant and tuple handling, including marshalling and unmarshalling functions for various data types, and internal data structures for managing GVariant objects within a GDBus client context.

classes.name: gdbus_client::GDBusVariant
classes.description: Represents a variant type for GDBus communication, managing GVariant references and providing methods to retrieve typed values.

classes.name: gdbus_client::GDBusTuple
classes.description: Represents a tuple of GVariants, supporting conversion to string and assignment from a vector of variants.

methods.name: GDBusVariant::getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an int32 value from the variant if of correct type.

methods.name: GDBusVariant::getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the variant if of correct type.

methods.name: GDBusVariant::getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value from the variant if of correct type.

methods.name: GDBusVariant::getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the variant if of correct type.

methods.name: GDBusTuple::toString
methods.description: Converts the tuple to a string representation.

methods.name: converters::marshal
methods.description: Serializes C++ types into GVariant objects for D-Bus communication.

methods.name: converters::unmarshal
methods.description: Deserializes GVariant objects into C++ types.
